user.description: Add the Calendar Actions services: create recurring events, and update, delete and list events on calendars that support it.

invalid_range.message: The end of the time range must be after its start.

event_not_found.message: No event with uid {uid} and recurrence_id {recurrence_id} was found.

series_start_unknown.message: The series {uid} may have started before the search window, so its start is unknown. Pass dtstart and dtend for the whole series.

dtend_required.message: dtstart changes between a date and a date-time; pass dtend as well.

nothing_to_update.message: Pass at least one event field to update.

create_event.name: Create event
create_event.description: Creates a calendar event, optionally recurring via an RFC 5545 recurrence rule.

entity_id.name: Calendar
entity_id.description: The calendar entity to add the event to.

dtstart.name: Start
dtstart.description: Start as an ISO 8601 date (all-day event, e.g. 2026-10-26) or date-time with offset (e.g. 2026-10-26T19:00:00+01:00).

dtend.name: End
dtend.description: End, the same type as start. For an all-day event it is the day after the last day (exclusive).

rrule.name: Recurrence rule
rrule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE without the "RRULE:" prefix. FREQ must be DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or YEARLY. Examples: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO | FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU,TH | FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=3SA | FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=10 | FREQ=YEARLY;UNTIL=20301231.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Updates an event, a single instance of a recurring event, or an instance and all following ones. Only the fields passed change; get uid and recurrence_id from list_events.

entity_id.name: Calendar
entity_id.description: The calendar entity that holds the event.

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: Instance recurrence_id from list_events. Omit to update the whole event or series.

recurrence_range.name: Recurrence range
recurrence_range.description: THISANDFUTURE updates the instance given by recurrence_id and all following instances. Omit to update only that instance.

dtstart.name: Start
dtstart.description: New start (ISO 8601 date or date-time with offset). If end is omitted, the event keeps its duration.

dtend.name: End
dtend.description: New end, the same type as start.

rrule.name: Recurrence rule
rrule.description: New RFC 5545 RRULE without the "RRULE:" prefix, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE. Only for the whole series or THISANDFUTURE.

description.name: Description
description.description: New description; an empty string clears it.

location.name: Location
location.description: New location; an empty string clears it.

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Deletes an event, a single instance of a recurring event, or an instance and all following ones. Get uid and recurrence_id from list_events.

entity_id.name: Calendar
entity_id.description: The calendar entity that holds the event.

recurrence_id.name: Recurrence ID
recurrence_id.description: Instance recurrence_id from list_events. Omit to delete the whole event or series.

recurrence_range.name: Recurrence range
recurrence_range.description: THISANDFUTURE deletes the instance given by recurrence_id and all following instances. Omit to delete only that instance.

list_events.name: List events
list_events.description: Lists events in a time range with uid, recurrence_id and rrule, which update_event and delete_event need.

entity_id.name: Calendar
entity_id.description: The calendar entity to list events from.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the range; defaults to now.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the range. Pass either end or duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the range from start. Pass either end or duration.
